TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: A user task with priority level, optional due date, optional reminder timestamp, optional category tag, and bounded subtask checklist.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document.

completed.description: Whether the task is marked complete.

dueAtMillis.description: Optional due date timestamp in UTC epoch milliseconds.

reminderAtMillis.description: Optional local reminder timestamp in UTC epoch milliseconds.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether due-date reminder notification is active.

categoryId.description: Optional ID referencing a CategoryTag document under /users/{userId}/categories.

subtasks.description: Bounded list (max 30) of subtask objects containing id, title, and completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

CategoryTag.title: CategoryTag
CategoryTag.description: A custom user-defined project or category tag for organizing tasks.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document.

tone.description: Editorial ink tone identifier for the tag pill.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-owned tasks with priority, due date, reminders, tags, and subtasks.
